ukmt-stmc-2019-20-regional-crossnumber-0.title: Work through the clues
ukmt-stmc-2019-20-regional-crossnumber-0.body:
**Clues that stand alone.** 4A $=361-20=341$. 4D $=400-19=381$. 11A: ELEVEN has $6$ letters with E three times, so $\frac{6!}{3!}=120$. 10D: THIRTY has T twice, so $\frac{6!}{2!}=360$. 15A $=1+1296+81+256=1634$. 18D $=4096+16+0+4096=8208$. 18A: $3125^{160}\times256^{100}=5^{800}\cdot2^{800}=10^{800}$, which has $801$ digits. 21D: $1024^{16}\times625^{40}=2^{160}5^{160}=10^{160}$, which has $161$ digits. 25A $=\frac13\cdot(120-2)\cdot180=7080$. 7D $=\frac1{60}(360-2)\cdot180=1074$. 24A: the product of the roots of $m^2-42m+341=0$ is $341$. 19D: the product of the roots of $n^2-29n+120=0$ is $120$.

**Fibonacci clues.** 15D: the two longest sides of the triangle are 8A and $145$. A three-digit Fibonacci number $144,233,377,610,987$ making a right-angled triangle with $145$ and having integer sides is $144$ (sides $17,144,145$) or $377$ (sides $145,348,377$); the latter gives an area of $25230$, which has five digits, so 8A $=144$ and 15D $=\frac12\cdot144\cdot17=1224$. 9A: with 14D one of $144,233,377,610,987$, the distance is $\sqrt{(110-14D)^2+1200^2}$, which is an integer only for 14D $=610$ ($500^2+1200^2=1300^2$). So 14D $=610$ and 9A $=1300$.

**Combining.** 16D $=\frac{144+610}2=377$. 3D $=8208+2\cdot1634=11476$. 17D $=11476+341=11817$. 1A $=\frac{8208+381+144}3=2911$. 22A $=341+341+120=802$. 21D $=161$, so 23A $=802-161=641$. 5D $=641-120=521$.

**Using crossings.** 18A $=801=9\cdot89$, so 6A is a multiple of $89$ of the form $1?8$ (crossing 3D and 4D): $178$. 13A is a multiple of $144$ of the form $?064$ (crossing 10D, 14D, 7D): $8064=144\cdot56$. 20A has the form $2?71$ (crossing 15D, 16D, 21D) and is a multiple of $11$: $2871=11\cdot261$. 2D is $9?10$ and 12D is $2?6$ with 12D a factor of 2D: the only possibility is $9310=266\cdot35$.

Every clue is satisfied by the completed grid shown in the answer.
